text: - Evidence: Issue's own invariants: "Diagnostic surface is dev-build-only… `nmp-devtools` is a separate crate behind an off-by-default cargo feature, never linked by app code; CI asserts each platform's release-artifact dependency graph contains no `nmp-devtools`." It cannot be a 1.0 public-crate blocker because it is mechanically excluded from release artifacts. Flagship consumer is chirp#30 (external app). Most phases (B/C/D/E) are still open with large items (headless host runner, MCP server, Chirp pane) — clearly a post-v1 build-out.
